name: VRM_CREATE_CARVEOUTS_INT
description: VRM_CREATE_CARVEOUTS_INT contains carve out adjustment information during carve out creation process.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: MEA_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number of a MEA transaction.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the MEA transaction.

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_METHOD
columns.description: Carve-out method that specifies a revenue complaince adjustment for a MEA. The valid values from VRM_MEA_CRAVEOUT_METHOD lookup are Relative and Residual.

columns.name: TOTAL_HDR_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Total fair market value amount of the MEA.

columns.name: PARENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a MEA parent line.

columns.name: TOTAL_LINE_FMV_AMOUNT
columns.description: Fair market value amount of the MEA line.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_LOW
columns.description: Low price of the tolerance range.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_HIGH
columns.description: High price of the tolerance range.

columns.name: FAIR_MARKET_VALUE
columns.description: A fair market value of an item, item group, or memo line in entered currency.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of source document.

columns.name: UNIT_REVENUE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit revenue price of a line to be recognized by a revenue recognition process.

columns.name: DELIVERY_STATUS
columns.description: Delivery status of a source document. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS.

columns.name: FMV_REPRESENTATION_TYPE
columns.description: FMV price representation type. The value is derived from VRM_FMV_REPRESENTATIONS lookup type.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of a revenue line.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price of the source document.

columns.name: DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: Discount percentage of the source document.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price represented in terms of percentage of base price.

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of the source document.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit revenue price after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Revenue line amount for a MEA line after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_UNIT_LIST_PRICE_DISC
columns.description: Unit list price discount percentage after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: ADJ_REV_BASE_PRICE_PERCENT
columns.description: Base price percentage after a carve out adjustment.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FMV_TOLERANCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the fair market value tolerance range level used to calculate the carve-out adjustment.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the batch to be processed.

columns.name: FMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: Fair market value line identifier.

columns.name: REVISED_COST
columns.description: Adjusted cost of sale after the document is revised.

columns.name: REVIEW_STATUS
columns.description: Review status of the VSOE value. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_VALUE_REVIEW_STATUS.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE
columns.description: Unit price in terms of unit selling price, discount percent, or any other representation type.

columns.name: COMPLIANCE_STATUS
columns.description: Compliance status of a MEA. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_COMPLIANCE_STATUS.

columns.name: BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Base price used to validate the VSOE value of a MEA line.

columns.name: UNIT_LIST_PRICE
columns.description: Unit list price percent used to validate the VSOE value of a MEA line.

columns.name: MFMV_LINE_ID
columns.description: MEA fair market value line identifier.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_DISCOUNT_PCT
columns.description: Discount percentage after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PCT_BASE_PRICE
columns.description: Unit sales percent base price after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: REVISED_GROSS_MARGIN_PCT
columns.description: Adjusted gross margin of sales after the document is revised.

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount after adjusting return amount.

columns.name: DELIVERED_FLAG
columns.description: Flag that indicates a delivery status of a source document.

columns.name: MEA_ID
columns.description: MEA transaction unique identifier.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Element is a deliverable or separate unit of accounting. Used to group element types for FMV sets. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of a source document line.
